description: Compute a one-day timetable: lay an ordered list of games onto parallel courts and fixed-length time slots from a start time, giving each game a court and HH:MM start, plus the end time. Use when you already know the day's games. Do NOT use to decide who plays whom (use round_robin_schedule) or to size a whole season (use season_plan).

courts.description: Number of courts/pitches usable at the same time, integer 1-12, e.g. 2

games.description: Games in the order they should be played (non-empty); e.g. one round's fixtures from round_robin_schedule

slot_minutes.description: Length of one game slot in minutes, integer 10-180, e.g. 40

start_time.description: First game start, 24h HH:MM, e.g. "09:00" or "18:30"

name: match_day_plan

courts.description: Number of courts used in parallel

end_time.description: Time the last slot finishes, 24h HH:MM (wraps past midnight)

slot_minutes.description: Length of each slot in minutes

start_time.description: First slot start time, 24h HH:MM (echoed from input)

timeline.description: One entry per game, in input order

total_minutes.description: Total duration from first start to last finish, in minutes

title: Match day plan
